architecture:
PRINCIPLE: the engine already owns disguise truth, the papers protocol, and every guard reaction; script owns exactly one thing — the map-scoped QUIET/LOUD state and the loadout consequence. No detection logic is reimplemented in script.

ENGINE LAYER (already live + one new change):
- Per-frame disguise parity (player.cpp:5482-5518, g_coopDisgParity=1, bug-1638): m_bIsDisguised recomputed every frame in every gametype — holstered or InventoryItem-in-hand = disguised, real weapon drawn = blown, level.alarm or !has_disguise = never, veto only from an attacker with GetCurrentThreat()>0 (bug-1631 fix, verified at :5511).
- Native challenge machinery untouched: sentry WAIT->PAPERS->ACCEPT/DENY, officer Fake_Papers dead-end, salute, none — all driven by m_ShowPapersTime vs Begin-snapshot (inventoryitem.cpp:81-84). These ARE expectations 3/4/6/7; we do not shadow them.
- NEW ENGINE CHANGE E1 (the plan's one deliberate engine edit, game.dll-only): PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise (actor.cpp ~9039) retargets its sight trace from the hardcoded G_GetEntity(0)->centroid to m_Enemy->centroid, with a NULL/m_Enemy guard. Only reachable with a confirmed disguised enemy; solo-host behavior identical. Without it, guards only initiate checks on players 2-4 while the HOST's chest is traceable, and an empty slot 0 is a crash site — expectation 3 ("all players ... to any guard") is unmeetable without this line.

SCRIPT LAYER (small director + existing chokepoints):
- One new file coop_mod/stealth.scr (~100 lines): owns level.coop_stealthPhase ("quiet"/"loud"; NIL on every other map = all gates inert), the single idempotent goLoud entry, and one debounced engine-truth watchdog. Nothing else writes the phase.
- Unarmed window = the existing level-flag trio (coop_noWeapon + coop_startUnarmed + coop_forcePapersEquip) armed at MAP LOAD in maps/m2l2a.scr's MP branch (the :38-42 block, promoted from experimental cvar-gate to default). All EIGHT weapon-grant sites already consult coop_noWeapon (managePlayerInventory:745 early-exit, spawnWeaponAssert, backfillPrimaries, giveSidearmPick, dbno_enter:231, dbno_ai_revive:728, medkit:376, armOnBlown itself) — no grant path needs touching.
- Per-body re-establishment = the existing block ABOVE the coop_noWeapon exit (itemhandler.scr:710-742, verified :728/:759): giveDisguiseOnSpawn re-latches engine has_disguise on every new body, papers item + givePapersFlag + forcePapersInHand. This single block covers first join, death respawn, DBNO-corpse respawn, spectate return, reconnect, and late join, because playerSpawnEvent -> manageAliveSpawning -> managePlayerInventory is the ONE inventory funnel every body passes through.
- Loud flip = the existing single funnel itemhandler.scr::coop_armOnBlown (:1394): clears the trio FIRST, then arms every active player. stealth.scr::goLoud is a thin wrapper that stamps the phase, prints a ^~^~^ST marker, and waitthreads armOnBlown. Alarm keeps its existing wiring (alarm_system.scr:704 takeAllDisguises -> armOnBlown), preserving the mod's permanent disguise loss on alarm.
- Detection stays engine-native; script merely LISTENS at the engine's own escalation points: coop preambles in anim/disguise_enemy.scr + anim/disguise_halt.scr (the anims the engine plays exactly when a checker goes hostile) thread goLoud, plus a 0.5s two-sample watchdog reading the parity getter (a player with has_disguise, empty/inventory hands, no alarm, whose is_disguised reads FALSE can only mean the engine veto fired = a real attacker with threat>0 exists).
- Scene purity during QUIET: aihandler suppresses replica cloning and the 12% prone personality roll while phase=="quiet" (NIL-inert elsewhere); aimaneuver gains a per-target skip for actors whose enemy is engine-disguised (zero-threat trackers must not be runto'd mid-interrogation); disguiseHandler's last mod-flag read (:1021) moves to the engine getter, completing bug-1639 parity.
per_expectation: EXP 1 — UNARMED ACROSS EVERY LIFECYCLE: maps/m2l2a.scr MP branch sets level.coop_noWeapon=true + level.coop_startUnarmed=1 + level.coop_forcePapersEquip=true at map load (existing :38-42 block made the default path; coop_stealthStart becomes a kill-switch defaulting ON in autoexec/coop_defaults). Because the flags are LEVEL-scoped and armed before any spawn, every body — first spawn, death respawn (manageDead -> respawn -> manageAliveSpawning), DBNO true-death respawn AND dbno_corpse_revive respawn, spectate return (manageSpectator/specReturn), disconnect+reconnect (full first-join path), and mid-mission join — funnels through managePlayerInventory (itemhandler.scr:695) whose takeall is followed by the coop_noWeapon early-exit (:745): no grant ever happens. DBNO stays empty-handed by the existing dbno.scr:231 gate; both revive chains (dbno.scr:728, medkit.scr:376) skip their weapon re-give on the same flag. Disguise/papers pickups grant only InventoryItems, so 'after picking up disguise/papers (level 1 or 2)' players remain weaponless: items.scr papers add_item paths and giveUniformToAll touch no weapon slot. World-drop containment stays via coop_stealthStripWeapons at the uniform scene (m2l2a.scr:833). No takeall is ever added — unarmed comes from never granting (e1l3 semantics, bug-1604's lesson).

EXP 2 — ONE UNIFORM PICKUP ARMS THE WHOLE TEAM WITH THE DISGUISE: already the shipped shape, kept verbatim: likeynorway (trigger_useonce) -> items.scr add_item uniform + papers_level1 -> giveUniformToAll + giveDisguiseToAll (itemhandler.scr:991, engine has_disguise latched per player) + givePapersFlagToAll (:2530), and level.coop_itemPapers/level.coop_enableDisguises persist the grant at LEVEL scope so late joiners and every respawned body re-acquire it through the per-body block at itemhandler.scr:710-742 (giveDisguiseOnSpawn :921 + papers + forcePapersInHand — verified this block sits ABOVE the coop_noWeapon exit, so it runs during the unarmed window; bug-1624's unreachable-hook failure cannot recur). One addition: a bounded-retry guard (3 attempts) in giveDisguiseToAll's failure loop, since under per-frame parity a player who is mid-weapon-raise legitimately reads undisguised and the current loop recurses unbounded (R5 open question). The uniform MODEL swap (giveUniformToPlayer :856) is cosmetic to the engine and rides level.coop_uniformOnSpawn; the armory-skin re-force in manageAliveSpawning gets a coop_hasEnemyUniform guard so it stops visually stomping the disguise model.

EXP 3 — SHOW PAPERS AT WILL, PROVABLY UNABLE TO BREAK ANY CHECK: mechanism is the engine's own, end-to-end. The papers InventoryItem's primary fire plays show_papers.skc whose TIKI server-frame commands at frames 30/40/50/60/70 each fire 'activatepapers' -> InventoryItem::ActivatePapers (inventoryitem.cpp:81-84) -> owner->m_ShowPapersTime = level.inttime. Every checker snapshots ITS enemy's m_ShowPapersTime at disguise-think Begin and compares snapshot < current in its PAPERS state. This is why at-will showing CANNOT break anything: (a) m_ShowPapersTime is a per-Sentient monotonically-stamped field with exactly ONE writer — a wave BEFORE a challenge starts is invisible to that challenge (snapshot taken after the wave is >= the stamp), a wave DURING the PAPERS state resolves accept/deny exactly as vanilla, and multiple players' stamps are independent, each checker reading only its own enemy's; (b) the papers item is an InventoryItem, so holding/firing it keeps m_bIsDisguised true (player.cpp:5480 '!pWeap || IsSubclassOfInventoryItem()' — the bug-1617 rule, already mirrored in weaponstate.scr's coop_isDisguised writer); (c) one fire gives ~5 stamp chances across the anim. UX plumbing (all existing, preserved): forcePapersInHand (main.scr:1015) puts papers in hand on every spawn while coop_forcePapersEquip; coop_papersAnytime (itemhandler.scr:1207) lets primary-fire-while-unarmed present papers any time; enableClickablePapers (:2546) covers the interrogation window. Officer-type checkers going hostile on a papers-show is vanilla design, not breakage — that is EXP 4's trigger. TWO fixes make 'any guard on the map' literally true: E1 (actor.cpp sight-trace retarget to m_Enemy) so checks initiate against non-host players, and the bug-1631 deferred-retirement fix in coop_paperPassAll (itemhandler.scr:1176): poll the accepting guard until his thinkstate leaves the disguise state (or 3.5s timeout) BEFORE issuing type_disguise 'none', eliminating the confirmed mid-ACCEPT freeze so an accepted guard remains a functioning actor.

EXP 4 — DETECTION BY PAPERS-CHECKING AI GOES LOUD: the officer's Fake_Papers machine (papers shown OR 12s -> ENEMY; walked away -> HALT) and a failed/timed-out sentry check both end with the engine playing anim/disguise_enemy.scr or anim/disguise_halt.scr — the exact frames the AI 'alerts as normal'. NEW coop preamble lines in those two anim scripts (pattern-matching the seven existing [200] preambles) thread coop_mod/stealth.scr::goLoud when self.enemy is a player and level.coop_stealthPhase=='quiet' (NIL-inert on all other maps); the existing attackPlayer-funnel preamble behavior is retained beneath (at that moment the target is engine-undisguised by definition — the actor is entering ATTACK — so no latch-on-disguised violation). goLoud (idempotent, one-shot) -> waitthread itemhandler::coop_armOnBlown: clears coop_startUnarmed/coop_noWeapon/coop_forcePapersEquip FIRST (bug-1607 ordering), then giveWeaponLoadout + activatePlayerWeapon for every coop_isActive==1 alive player. Because the trio is cleared at LEVEL scope, EVERY later lifecycle event — death, dbno (pistol now granted at dbno.scr:231), respawn, spectate return, reconnect, join — flows through the untouched normal arming path and spawns LOUD/armed with zero additional hooks. Backstops: the existing coop_blownOnDamage poll (m2l2a.scr:571, damage + attacking German within 1600u), and the NEW stealth.scr watchdog: 0.5s poll, two consecutive samples where any active player has has_disguise + no real weapon in hand + !level.alarm yet is_disguised==0 — under parity that combination can only mean the engine veto fired, i.e. an actor with m_Enemy==player, IsAttacking, threat>0 exists (bug-1631's threat clause makes zero-threat limbo actors incapable of false-triggering it). Sentry DENY remains non-hostile (wave-off, re-challenge later) exactly as vanilla — deny is NOT a loud trigger.

EXP 5 — ANY ALARM GOES LOUD IDENTICALLY: already wired and kept: alarm_system_master (global/alarm_system.scr:688-704) sets level.alarm=1 and calls takeAllDisguises (itemhandler.scr:1138) whose tail chains coop_armOnBlown — same funnel, same trio clear, same all-future-spawns-armed consequence as EXP 4. The engine independently voids every player's is_disguised while level.m_bAlarm is up (player.cpp maintenance) and dumps every disguise-state actor to ATTACK on their next tick, so AI reaction is pure vanilla. All alarm ENTRY paths converge on the master trigger (ai_gofor_alarm switch race, player touching/using a switch, m2l2a's alarmall label), so no per-path work is needed. The bug-1639 guard in ai_alarm_alerted (pre-alarm, a disguised-contact trip is dropped) stays — it prevents the recorded false-ring class without touching legitimate rings. The mod's permanent takeAllDisguises-on-alarm (a deliberate deviation from vanilla's recoverable alarm) is RETAINED as current behavior; restoring vanilla recoverable-alarm is flagged as a separate user decision (R6 open question), not smuggled into this design.

EXP 6 — ALL AI PLAY VANILLA SCRIPTS/ANIMS: achieved by REMOVING interference, not adding management. (a) The three raw coop aggro sources stay behind the shipped per-target engine-is_disguised gates (aihandler.scr:1193/1218/1234 — replica targeting, aisquad go-loud/search full stand-down incl. forceactivate, morale berserk; verified in tree); blocked attempts leave no trace (no last-known stamping). (b) Officer wave layer stays 'deferred' for m2l2a (officer.scr::coop_officer_policy — nothing spawns pre-alarm). (c) NEW: aimaneuver.scr per-target gate — skip any actor whose enemy is engine-disguised, closing the R4 gap where a zero-threat TRACKING guard (engine retention, actorenemy.cpp:446) could be runto+forceactivate'd mid-interrogation, yanking his anim. (d) NEW: while level.coop_stealthPhase=='quiet', aihandler suppresses replica cloning and the 12% prone personality roll for this map's actors (both R4 open risks to the card trio/scientists/welders; suppression keyed on the phase var = NIL-inert on all other maps; post-loud both resume). (e) Card trio: prevention only — the bug-1637 cardgame shim (MP wait-0.5) lets the RETAIL manager run and is evaluated as-is before anything is added; no type_disguise swaps ever issued while an actor may be inside a disguise think (bug-1631 rule), which the deferred-retirement paperPassAll fix enforces at the one offending site. (f) Norway pair keeps the coop 'none'+waitForEnemy arrangement (SP-gated salute flip stays — the recorded saluter-trap). (g) One-line per-target is_disguised gate on wounded.scr:219 closes the morale-falter raw-attackplayer corner. All retail scene labels (cardgame3, wall/table scientists + interrogation, welders, sledgehammer, wrenchman, crate movers, cometolife crane, officer1 office walk, whattheydoin, norgirls, specialmove, intercom/wavelaps) are untouched.

EXP 7 — LOUD = PRECISELY VANILLA COVER-BLOWN: once loud, script gets out of the way. Players armed = weapon drawn = is_disguised false per frame; the engine threat pipeline (visibility latched at 1.0 for anyone who ever fully saw a player -> threat 10000+) drives attacks natively; disguise-state actors bail to ATTACK; $ai_alarm actors run the vanilla alerted->switch-race->alarm flow; alarm backups spawn per retail (forceactivate + runtoClosest, never attackplayer — the proven disguise-respecting reinforcement shape); scene actors fire their retail alarmthreads (ohnothenaxos1 scientists, cower, weldinginterupt) exactly as authored; officer waves release via the 'deferred' policy poll on level.alarm. The per-target aggro gates (aisquad/morale/replica/aimaneuver) all open automatically because their condition — target engine-disguised, no alarm — is false. The QUIET-phase suppressions (cloning, prone roll) lift on the phase flip so post-loud combat dynamics (coop_aiDynamic juke/hide, squad, morale) run at their shipped defaults. goLoud deliberately does NOT force level.alarm=1: vanilla cover-blown is 'local attackers + the alarm race decides the bell', and forcing the bell would spawn backups instantly and diverge from vanilla — the bell rings when the ringers reach a switch, as authored. PRESERVED verbatim: naxos hold-USE quiet sabotage (coop_naxosSabotage, coop_naxosQuiet skips the bust, caught-in-the-act via guy1-3 cansee -> goLoud), and the objective toast prompts (coop_objToastStart + coop_obj_toast_all sites).
file_changes: maps/m2l2a.scr — promote the stealth trio arming (:38-42) from coop_stealthStart-gated experiment to the default MP path (cvar kept as kill-switch, seeded 1); delete the two dead 'setcvar coop_stealthNoAggro 0' lifts in coop_naxosCaught (:493) and coop_blownOnDamage (:592) and route both through stealth.scr::goLoud; keep coop_naxosSabotage, toasts, coop_stealthStripWeapons (:833), waitForEnemy, and all retail scene labels untouched.

coop_mod/stealth.scr (NEW, ~100 lines) — single owner of level.coop_stealthPhase ('quiet' set at m2l2a load, NIL elsewhere); goLoud: idempotent one-shot (^~^~^ST LOUD marker, reason arg) -> waitthread itemhandler::coop_armOnBlown; watchdog thread: 0.5s poll over $player (1-indexed, coop_isActive==1 filter, entities never parked in containers — bug-1632 discipline), two-consecutive-sample debounce on (has_disguise && unarmed-hand && !level.alarm && is_disguised==0) -> goLoud; exits permanently on phase=='loud'.

openmohaa-hzm/code/fgame/actor.cpp — E1: PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise (~:9039) sight trace retargeted from G_GetEntity(0)->centroid to m_Enemy->centroid with NULL guard (game.dll-only; deploy to BOTH roots per bug-1634, string-scan the packaged dll for the marker per bug-1635).

hzm-mohaa-coop-mod cfgs (autoexec.cfg + coop_defaults.cfg) — flip coop_stealthStart seed 0->1 (the :1171-1176 revert block); coop_stealthNoAggro stays 0 (dead cvar, no longer read); g_coopDisgParity remains default 1 (live kill-switch).
loud_state_machine:
TWO STATES, ONE-WAY PER MAP RUN, ONE OWNER (coop_mod/stealth.scr; state var level.coop_stealthPhase, NIL on non-stealth maps so every gate is inert elsewhere).

STATE QUIET (entered at map load, m2l2a MP branch): level.coop_noWeapon=1, coop_startUnarmed=1, coop_forcePapersEquip=1, coop_stealthPhase='quiet'. Invariants: no weapon grant anywhere (all 8 grant sites consult coop_noWeapon); every new body re-latches has_disguise + papers via itemhandler:710-742; papers presentable at will (forcePapersInHand + papersAnytime + clickablePapers); engine parity computes is_disguised per frame; per-target aggro gates + phase suppressions (cloning/prone/aimaneuver) protect scenes; DBNO players stay empty-handed (bleedout risk accepted, coop_blownOnDamage usually arms first). Sentry DENY and transient CURIOUS episodes do NOT leave this state.

TRANSITIONS TO LOUD (all funnel through stealth.scr::goLoud -> itemhandler::coop_armOnBlown; idempotent, armOnBlown's coop_startUnarmed==1 guard makes double-fire harmless):
- T1 ALARM: alarm_system_master (level.alarm=1) -> takeAllDisguises -> armOnBlown (existing wiring; disguises additionally removed permanently — current mod semantics retained).
- T2 CHECKER ALERT: engine plays anim/disguise_enemy.scr or disguise_halt.scr on a player-enemy (officer papers-shown/12s-timeout, sentry ENEMY/HALT exits) -> preamble threads goLoud.
- T3 NAXOS CAUGHT: coop_naxosCaught (guy1-3 cansee during hold-USE) -> goLoud (replaces the dead setcvar wiring).
- T4 DAMAGE: coop_blownOnDamage poll (HP drop + attacking German within 1600u) -> goLoud.
- T5 ENGINE-TRUTH WATCHDOG: two consecutive 0.5s samples of any active player with has_disguise + unarmed hand + !alarm but is_disguised==0 — only possible when the parity veto fired, i.e. a real attacker with GetCurrentThreat()>0 exists (covers scripted busts like the loud $naxos walk-in with zero per-site wiring).

STATE LOUD (entry action, all inside armOnBlown in this order per bug-1607): clear coop_startUnarmed + coop_noWeapon + coop_forcePapersEquip FIRST; then per active alive player giveWeaponLoadout + activatePlayerWeapon (raising a real weapon flips is_disguised false same-frame); stamp phase='loud' (watchdog + suppressions exit). Consequences: every subsequent lifecycle event (death, dbno — pistol now granted, revive chains re-give, spectate return, reconnect, late join) arms through the UNTOUCHED normal path because the trio is level-scoped and gone; AI behavior is pure vanilla cover-blown (engine threat pipeline, alarm race, retail alarmthreads, officer waves released by the 'deferred' policy on level.alarm). Disguise persistence follows vanilla rules: T2-T5 leave has_disguise intact (holster = regain cover, the vanilla armed-but-holstered contract — keeps the post-Naxos papers2/sentry2 keystone winnable), while T1 alarm removes disguises permanently via takeAllDisguises. Edge: a DBNO player passes armOnBlown's alive test and receives a kit while down (activatePlayerWeapon no-ops); the revive chain re-gives normally — documented, accepted.
why_ledger_safe: Every recorded failure class is either structurally avoided or its recorded fix direction is what ships. STRIP/ORDERING CLASS — bug-1604 (takeall wiped the uniform): zero new takeall; unarmed = never-grant via coop_noWeapon (the e1l3 recipe the ledger says to reuse). bug-1624 (armed-at-pickup ordering + hook below the early-exit): trio armed at MAP LOAD; the per-body hook is the existing block verified ABOVE the :745 exit (:710-742). bug-1606 (strip-by-class broke the holster mirror): no strip-by-class anywhere. bug-1607 (armOnBlown ordering): untouched, already clears flags before re-give; we only add callers. bug-1603/1617 (NIL!=NULL, papers-in-hand rule): no new weaponstate logic; the engine's InventoryItem rule is the single source, existing NIL-guarded UX paths reused verbatim. AGGRO CLASS — bugs 1615/1616/1618/1639: no new attackplayer/latch sites at all; the new hooks (disguise_enemy/halt preambles) fire only when the engine itself is entering ATTACK on an already-undisguised target, and they call goLoud (arms players), never latch; the alarm's structural bypass is irrelevant because T1 hooks the master, not the wrapper; per-target engine-flag deference (shipped, verified :1193/:1218/:1234) is extended to the two remaining raw corners (aimaneuver, wounded:219) rather than bypassed. bug-1630 (no hook for engine-legit busts): T2 is a deterministic engine-anim hook and T5 is the parity-derived backstop — both engine-truth, and T4 keeps the recorded poll (not waittill damage, per the ArmorDamage caveat). bug-1631 — freeze arm: the exact recorded fix direction is implemented (paperPassAll defers type_disguise 'none' until the think exits); oscillation: already fixed by the threat>0 veto (verified player.cpp:5511), and T5 cannot false-fire on zero-threat limbo actors because the veto itself requires threat>0; no type_disguise swap can ever land mid-think. bug-1632 (5 failed resolver attempts): the director stores NO player entities in script containers, passes numbers only, iterates $player 1-indexed with the coop_isActive filter, and never NULL-tests $player[i] — the A6/player_closestTo discipline. bugs 1636/1637 (card players): prevention-only stance kept — the shimmed retail manager is evaluated before anything new; QUIET-phase suppression of forceactivate-issuing systems (cloning, prone, aimaneuver) removes the known yank vectors instead of adding a repair loop. HARNESS/DEPLOY — bugs 1619/1633/1634/1635/1610: script-driven pickups for tests, exec start_server.cfg + ui_startdmmap 2, deploy game.dll to BOTH roots, string-scan the packaged binary, and compare pk3 timestamps vs InitGame before trusting any log. SUPERSEDED-PLAN GUARD: this design is built on the parity + per-target model (bugs 1638/1639), not the v1 plan's frozen-latch/whole-window premises (D4/D5), while keeping v1's still-valid assets (single-owner director, TP-1..TP-6 incl. the TP-1b post-Naxos keystone and the TP-4 E1 regression test, ^~^~^ST marker grammar). Parse discipline: all .scr edits ASCII/CRLF, depthscan2-verified, no em-dash/bare-negative/BOM.
risks: The entire parity stack (bugs 1638, 1639, 1631-veto, 1637 cardgame shim) is PENDING PLAYTEST — this design compounds on it; TP-1/TP-1b must pass before the new layers are judged.

E1 (actor.cpp sight-trace retarget) is a game.dll behavior change: solo-host should be identical, but any regression in SP-style challenge initiation lands on every disguise map (e1l3/e1l4 flows) — g_coopDisgParity-style cvar gate (g_coopDisgTraceEnemy, default 1) recommended, plus the bug-1634/1635 dual-root deploy + binary string-scan.

T2 preamble + existing attackPlayer funnel in disguise_enemy/halt can both act in the same frame; goLoud idempotence makes it safe, but ordering should be preamble-goLoud FIRST so players are armed before the funnel's bark/aggro propagates (verify with the ARMED marker — the never-measured mid-fight re-arm case from R6).

QUIET-phase suppression of replica cloning changes enemy-count scaling on m2l2a for 2+ players until loud; deliberate (scene purity beats scaling in a stealth window) but is a feel change to flag to the user.
armOnBlown arms DBNO players with a kit while down (alive test passes); revive chain re-gives — believed benign (R5 open question) but unverified for double-primary edges.
The permanent takeAllDisguises-on-alarm deviation is retained; with parity live, vanilla's recoverable alarm is now implementable and awaits a user decision — this design does not change it.
Sentry DENY and officer proximity remain vanilla-lethal design (officers unwinnable by construction); player education (don't show papers to officers) is a UX/toast concern outside this machine.

T5 watchdog reads is_disguised==0 as veto-fired; if a future engine change adds another false condition to the maintenance (e.g. new alarm-like flag), the watchdog inherits it — the two-sample debounce plus the has_disguise/unarmed/no-alarm preconditions are the guard.
